The models differ by design: rc3 BEAUti puts an exponential prior with an estimated mean (`bPopSizesInitialMean`, LogNormal(0, 8)) on the first skyline population size, where 2.7.9 has the improper Jeffreys prior (beast3 `05cba42`).
